verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments platform holding merchant transaction data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers payment-acceptance features, docs pages, and an llms.txt docs index. Machine-readable documentation is not export of the user's own data, and nothing documents exporting merchant data in open formats or offboarding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
